title: Wildlife
description: A walk from the canopy to the forest floor. Birds among the leaves give way to small details, reptiles in the shade, and a quiet stop by the water.

DSCF5425.jpg.title: Among the branches
DSCF5425.jpg.caption: A monkey rests above the ground, one arm raised to a branch. The walk begins in the canopy.
DSCF5425.jpg.alt: A grey monkey with a pale face and reddish legs sits in a tree, with one arm stretched up to a branch.

photo_2026-10-06 17.54.43.jpeg.title: Among the green leaves
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.43.jpeg.caption: A yellow bird sits deep in the foliage, framed by branches and leaves.
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.43.jpeg.alt: A yellow bird with a dark face sits partly hidden among green leaves and crossing branches.

DSCF5538.jpg.title: Through the leaves
DSCF5538.jpg.caption: Orange and black feathers appear through a gap in the foliage.
DSCF5538.jpg.alt: An orange-and-black bird looks down from between overlapping green leaves.

DSCF5491.jpg.title: Electric blue
DSCF5491.jpg.caption: Blue feathers and a yellow eye stand out against the green background.
DSCF5491.jpg.alt: An iridescent blue bird with a bright yellow eye perches on a thin branch against green foliage.

photo_2026-10-06 17.54.35.jpeg.title: On a thin branch
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.35.jpeg.caption: A small bird pauses on a branch, with its beak open and the leaves behind it out of focus.
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.35.jpeg.alt: A small brown-and-grey bird with a warm brown head and an open beak stands on a thin diagonal branch.

photo_2026-10-06 17.54.41.jpeg.title: Held by a thread
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.41.jpeg.caption: Long legs and fine strands of web stand out against soft green light.
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.41.jpeg.alt: A long-legged spider hangs in its web against a blurred green background.

photo_2026-10-06 17.54.34.jpeg.title: On the tree trunk
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.34.jpeg.caption: A snail holds to the bark. Its curved shell adds a small detail to the trunk.
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.34.jpeg.alt: A snail with a striped brown shell clings to the side of a tree trunk against green foliage.

photo_2026-10-06 17.54.31.jpeg.title: Beside the path
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.31.jpeg.caption: A lizard rests in the shade beside a low wooden barrier.
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.31.jpeg.alt: A large grey-brown lizard rests on soil and dry leaves beneath a low wooden barrier, with its head raised.

photo_2026-10-06 17.54.47.jpeg.title: Scales and fallen leaves
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.47.jpeg.caption: A snake lies among fallen leaves. Patches of light reveal the pattern of its scales.
photo_2026-10-06 17.54.47.jpeg.alt: A brown snake rests its head near fallen leaves, with its curved body extending to the right.

DSCF5573.jpg.title: Wings over the water
DSCF5573.jpg.caption: A brown bird spreads its wings in the shallows, with bright red birds behind it.
DSCF5573.jpg.alt: A brown wading bird spreads its wings in shallow water, with several vivid red birds in the background.

DSCF5547.jpg.title: Resting by the water
DSCF5547.jpg.caption: A duck rests on a mossy log. Fine feather patterns bring the walk to a quiet close.
DSCF5547.jpg.alt: A duck with a blue-grey bill and fine black-and-white feather patterns rests on a mossy log.
